# iGROW WORKS (استوديو آي غرو ووركس)

> Creative post-production and cinema-grade video editing studio led by Director Nomair (المخرج نمير), specializing in cinematic pacing, documentary editing, narrative fiction drama, sound design, and color grading.

## Canonical Identity & Knowledge Graph
- **Studio Official Name**: iGROW WORKS
- **Arabic Name**: استوديو آي غرو ووركس / استوديو نمير للمونتاج وصناعة الأفلام
- **Official Domain & Website**: https://igrow.now/
- **Founder & Director**: Nomair / المخرج نمير (Director & Lead Video Editor with 500+ career projects mastered across documentaries, drama, and commercials)
- **Lead Screenwriter & Story Architect**: Marie Bu / ماري بو
- **Official Contact**: nomair@igrow.now
- **Governing Year**: 2026

## Core Disciplines & Services (المجالات والخدمات)
1. **Directorial Cut & Narrative Pacing (المونتاج الإخراجي والسرد)**: Screenplay architecture, dramatic tension arcs, and rhythmic cinematic video editing.
2. **Documentary & Narrative Fiction Post-Production (مونتاج الأفلام الوثائقية والروائية)**: Complete post-production pipeline for long-form documentaries and narrative films.
3. **Cinema-Grade Sound Design & Color Grading (تصميم الصوت والتلوين السينمائي)**: Multi-layer sound mixing, audio dynamics, and DaVinci-grade color grading.
4. **Commercial Campaigns & Visual Packaging (الإعلانات الإخراجية)**: High-impact commercials crafted for high-growth creators, directors, and commercial brands.
5. **Private Collaboration Pipeline (منظومة الإنتاج السحابية)**: Frame.io frame-accurate timeline reviews, ultra-fast cloud ingest, and direct 1-on-1 communication with Director Nomair.
